verticalDatum: Official LAS2000.5, horizontal LKS92 TM EPSG3059. Architect drawing datum has no independently verified absolute tie.
sourceRasterEncoding: Derived two-meter fitting grid from classified class2 LAS ground; four-nearest binned-cell inverse-distance interpolation.

originalTiles.acquisitionDate: LAS creation date is not verified scanning date.
LAS creation date is not verified scanning date.

sources.transform: axis order change (2D) + Inverse of LKS-92 to WGS 84 (1) + Latvian Transverse Mercator + axis order change (2D)

courtFloorMethod: Maximum sampled fitted ground within each court plus0.12m. Medieval original courtY1.8 preserved relative to drawn architecture; forecourt uses separate fitted level. Unsurveyed floors.
limits: Ground dataset predates recent restoration: LAS file creation2016 is not a verified flight date. Current ground alterations and exact entrance levels remain unverified.
Two-meter bins and fitting grid are not surveyed positional accuracy. Empty building footprints are interpolated; retained nearest-cell gap statistics expose coverage limits.
Bounded buried foundation and separately fitted courtyard levels are reconstruction aids. Drawing datum, door levels, internal passages and forecourt connection are approximate. No terrain cutout.
Diagnostic ground is confined to168m square. Surrounding city, river, retaining walls, vegetation and garden details are not reconstructed.
